review_notes: I read the whole file. I did not check the IsCompletelyMonotone definition in Closure/Basic, so the exact form of the structure field is assumed from how it is used at lines 74, 97 and 156. I found one repeated-proof issue: the shift-compatibility argument is proved twice. The other proofs (comp_const_mul, sub_comp_add_const, comp_affine) are not duplicates. I could not compile the proposed rewrite, so it is a sketch.

findings.excerpt: have hset : a +ᵥ Ici (0 : ℝ) = Ici a := by
findings.problem: Two proofs repeat the same nontrivial argument that the within-`[0,∞)` iterated derivative of `s ↦ f (s + a)` at `t` equals that of `f` at `t + a`. Both prove `a +ᵥ Ici 0 = Ici a`. Both rewrite with `iteratedDerivWithin_comp_add_const` via `congrFun … t` and `simp only [hset] at hval`. Both then show `ContDiffAt` at `t + a > 0` using `isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds` and `Ioi_subset_Ici_self`, and convert to `iteratedDeriv` with `iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Ici a)`. The file already contains the general lemma `iteratedDerivWithin_Ici_comp_add_const` (a == 0 handled by `simp`), but it is declared after `comp_add_const`, so `comp_add_const` re-derives everything. It also carries its own boundary case split and a second `ContDiffAt` proof.
findings.proposed_change: Move `iteratedDerivWithin_Ici_comp_add_const` above `comp_add_const`, and optionally factor its `hset` into a small private lemma `vadd_Ici_zero : a +ᵥ Ici (0:ℝ) = Ici a`. Then shorten `comp_add_const` to: `refine ⟨hf.contDiffOn.comp (by fun_prop) hmaps, fun n t ht => ?_⟩; rw [iteratedDerivWithin_Ici_comp_add_const n (hf.contDiffOn.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) ha ht]; exact hf.neg_one_pow_mul_iteratedDerivWithin_nonneg n (by linarith)`. This is the same `of_le` coercion pattern used at line 156 in `sub_comp_add_const`. It removes the `hset`, `hval`, boundary-case and `ContDiffAt` blocks (about 25 lines) from `comp_add_const`. The branch `t + a = 0` needs no separate treatment, because the helper already handles `a = 0` by `simp`. The helper's hypotheses (`0 ≤ a`, `0 ≤ t`, `ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Ici 0)`) are all available from `ha`, `ht` and `hf`.
findings.benefit: The shift-compatibility fact is proved once and used by both `comp_add_const` and `sub_comp_add_const`. `comp_add_const` then reads as its mathematical content: the shifted derivative is the original at `t + a`, which is nonnegative. A future change to the `vadd` set or smoothness bookkeeping is made in one place.
